g.text: INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN, DESIGN CALCULATIONS
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-401 Servo auger filler (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN (record results here or in the MES)
Cabinet top flat, level; column bolt holes to the backing plate
Column square to the base plate, cap parallel to the base
Head plate: housing bore and column-cap holes true position
Housing bores Ø52 H7 coaxial; spigot Ø40 k6; spindle seats Ø25 k5; hub Ø68 H7
Hopper: cone round, ferrule square to the axis, product-contact welds ground flush
Surface Ra on hopper, agitator, lid underside, tooling
Auger in tube: radial clearance J 0.75, S 0.72 all round, run-out at the tip
Spindle axis to hopper outlet and stage centre
Agitator scraper clearance to the cone
Point-to-point wiring vs E01-E03; insulation 500 V DC power circuits (drive, PLC off)
PE continuity: cabinet, door, column, head, motor frames to the PE bar
Rotation: auger CCW seen from above (dosing), agitator direction per 500
Safety function: E-stop and flap each stop the auger (STO) and agitator; reset needed; single fault test
Servo tuning: no overshoot at the dose end; following error
Container sensor: dose blocked with no container on the stage
Calibration: 20 doses per container at rated speed, mean on target
Dose accuracy: 50 doses, standard deviation (shaker / jar / tub)
Rate: 12 shakers/min and 8 jars/min for 10 min, no bridging in the hopper
ATP swab after allergen wash (hopper cone, auger, tube)
Belt and chain tension, guard fixings, seal lips
Replace lip seals P1-433; check bearing noise
DOSE TABLE (bulk density 0.548 g/mL, fill efficiency 0.85; calibrate per T19)
cone 57° to the horizontal (≥ 55° for this blend)
refill by scoop through the flap
vs 3.0 N·m (J, full hopper): SF 1.51; peak 13.6
C = 14.8 kN; far beyond 40 kh target
#40 SS 15T / 30T, C 184; agitator 30 rpm, tip 0.68 m/s
head 40 kg + full hopper 37 kg at 300; 304 yield 205 MPa
< 0.5 keeps the auger centred in the tube
feet at y -160 / 360: stable, no anchor needed
